title: Successful STT run provenance v1
description: Provenance for one successful STT response saved on the Mac. This is not a semantic segmentation or speaker identity result. Structural validation alone does not verify file hashes or timestamp ordering.

input_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the original uploaded audio file bytes actually submitted for STT.

model.description: Actual requested model name captured before the request; not a claim about an unreported server-side model revision. Do not infer this field for legacy responses.

started_at.description: Timezone-qualified UTC timestamp captured for the request attempt.

completed_at.description: Timezone-qualified UTC timestamp of local raw response persistence, reconstructed from file mtime after a crash. This is not the provider's internal completion time.

raw_response_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the saved raw JSON file bytes, not the provider's original HTTP byte stream.

raw_response_path.description: Path relative to the private Mac data directory. The directory UUID must equal run_id. The immutable response snapshot is distinct from the legacy raw/<chunk_id>.json compatibility file.
